aboutPage.intro: Freelancing has allowed many professionals to work independently. But this independence has its limits: businesses often need comprehensive solutions requiring multiple areas of expertise that a single professional can't always provide. JUST ART meets this need by bringing together experts from different fields and offering management and training solutions.
aboutPage.goalsIntro: JUST ART is built on three core pillars:
goals: Bringing professionals together to offer a multidisciplinary service.
Supporting businesses with visual communication and management.
aboutPage.goalsClosing: Our philosophy is rooted in artistic originality and professionalism, giving our clients a unique position in the market.
aboutPage.story: JUST ART officially launched in 2025, after extensive reflection on the challenges designers face in gaining recognition in the market. Since digital presence is a key driver of business visibility, JUST ART leverages this reality to offer solutions tailored to entrepreneurs' needs.
aboutPage.modelIntro: JUST ART operates without fixed employees, working on a collaborative model:

levels.title: Level 1 collaborators
levels.description: directly involved in management and content creation.

aboutPage.modelClosing: Each professional keeps their independence while benefiting from being part of a network.
aboutPage.commitment: JUST ART aims to strengthen businesses' digital presence while offering young professionals real employment and training opportunities — an ecosystem that benefits both businesses and creative entrepreneurs, with a focus on innovation, quality, and social responsibility.
